entities.title: Run the repository checks
entities.summary: Install the one dependency and run the two checks CI runs.
entities.when: Before pushing any change to spec/, schema/, conformance/, docs/side-by-side.md or a UTV-first example test.
steps: python3 tools/side_by_side.py --check; if it reports the page out of date, run python3 tools/side_by_side.py and commit docs/side-by-side.md.
entities.verify: validate.py ends with "All structural checks passed." and side_by_side.py --check prints "docs/side-by-side.md is up to date".
